rule: Manual verifications. Apply after daily screening; keep unless newer exchange/RHP evidence contradicts.
f3_rule: F3 = post-issue P/E at or below 25x (positive). Loss-making or above 25x = FAIL. Source: Chittorgarh post-issue P/E; some use annualised recent-period earnings.
f8_rule: F8 passes when anchor investors are confirmed AND no auditor qualification/adverse opinion is found in public sources (soft pass; confirm in RHP). Fails if qualification found.
